title: panel doubt leg — adversarial findings on one artifact
description: Output contract of one doubt panel leg (references/doubt-driven-development.md Step 3). Issues only: status no_issues with an empty items array is how a leg states it cannot find any after thorough examination. The classifier assigns item ids <lab>-<n> by position.

status.description: issues: one or more entries below. no_issues: none found after thorough examination.

items.description: One entry per issue, most damaging first.

category.description: The adversarial prompt's list: unstated assumptions, edge cases not handled, hidden coupling or shared state, ways the contract could be violated, existing conventions this might break, failure modes under unexpected input.

where.description: The place in the ARTIFACT: a line, heading, or quoted phrase.

what.description: What is wrong, and the concrete input, sequence, or reading under which it fails.

basis.description: The ARTIFACT or CONTRACT text the issue rests on, quoted or located.
